use_case: AI eligibility assistant on the IEP (SYS-D2): extracts data from verification documents and recommends SNAP, TANF, and Medicaid eligibility outcomes to caseworkers
business_owner: GovTech Data and AI director (group); each state human services agency's program director (deployer)
vendor_or_model: Group-built feature on provider A's managed large language model service (government-community region; no-training and retention terms confirmed 2026-07)
data_categories: Applicant and household data; income and expense documents; Social Security numbers (Regulated); no FTI permitted
human_in_the_loop: State merit caseworkers make every determination. Recommendations paused from 2026-10-01; they return only with a review-first design, deterministic eligibility rules, caseworker reason codes in notices, and weekly supervisor review of AI-assisted denials
applicable_laws: 7 CFR 272.4(a)(2) and N92-R04 (42 CFR 431.10(b)(3), (c)) (merit staff and the single State agency decide); 7 CFR 273.10(g)(1)(ii), 273.15(a), 42 CFR 431.200(a) (notices and fair hearings); 7 CFR 273.2(g)(1), (i)(3)(i) (processing deadlines); 7 CFR 272.6(a) (nondiscrimination); 7 CFR 272.4(b) (bilingual service); N92-R04 (42 CFR 431.306(b)) and 7 CFR 272.1(c) (confidentiality); N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 sec. 2.C.11.2, no FTI); state data security law (Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) worked example); Colorado SB26-189 not applicable today (no Colorado IEP customer)
status: In production for caseworkers in 2 states since 2026-03; approved with conditions; recommendations paused from 2026-10-01 (POAM-016)

use_case: RMS AI report-writing assist: drafts incident report narratives from officer dictation and incident data
vendor_or_model: Group-built feature on provider A's managed large language model service (government-community region)
data_categories: Officer dictation; incident data; names and criminal history references (CJI)
human_in_the_loop: Officers review, edit, and sign every report. No new beta agencies; CJI to the model service stopped by 2026-10-01 until the CJIS review is complete
applicable_laws: N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 SA-9, SC-28; Security Addendum in each RMS agency agreement); agency evidence and discovery rules (generic, by state); SOC 2 commitments (CC2.3, CC3.4, CC8.1, CC9.2); N51-R01 (FTC Act Sec. 5, product claims)
status: Beta with 37 agencies since 2026-04-06; not approved for general release; conditions in P10 section 6 (POAM-022)
